submitted.rationale: With only 3 merit measurements, I measured one corner at a time: Co-rich (21), Mn-rich (146) and Ca-rich (80). All three photocurrents were about zero. The Mn-rich film 146 gave 0.0 A, the highest of the three and the only one that was not negative. The library looks mostly photo-inactive at 2.72 eV.

rejected.reason: Co-rich corner gave -6e-8 A, a negative photocurrent
Ca-rich corner gave -1.6e-7 A, the most negative of the three
